title: ID0445534-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP/R1 170001369] Update latest FW
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: error on both ports. Error on DC1 and DC2 regarding to ECOGs. 21.08.2025 arround 11 UTC, we have a lot errors having coap polling error. upload v8,
Solution: Change os-release from v7.0.6 to v7.0.5 because v8.0.5 hasn't got v7.0.6 in the permitted updates
